definition_en: a large meeting where people discuss a subject or share ideas
core_image: 长桌两旁坐满人，每人面前一支麦克风
scene: 各地医生聚在大厅里交流新研究。She met her future partner at a medical conference.
sceneCN: 这里 conference 指「会议」（第 1 个义项：多人聚集讨论专业问题的场合）；句意是她在一次医学会议上遇见了未来的伴侣。

senses.title: A large formal meeting
senses.definition: a large meeting where people discuss a shared subject
senses.definitionCN: 许多人聚集讨论共同主题的大型会议
senses.example: The annual conference drew two thousand guests.
senses.exampleCN: 年度会议吸引了两千名来宾。
senses.why: A shared subject gives strangers a reason to sit in one room.
senses.whyCN: 共同的主题让陌生人有了坐进同一个房间的理由。

senses.title: A private discussion
senses.definition: a private discussion between a few people before a decision
senses.definitionCN: 少数人在做决定前的私下商谈
senses.example: After a short conference, the two sides agreed.
senses.exampleCN: 短暂商谈之后，双方达成了一致。
senses.why: Some words are said best when only a few people are listening.
senses.whyCN: 有些话在只有少数人听的时候最好说。

intro.en: Conference comes from Latin conferentia, a bringing together, from conferre, to bring together.
intro.cn: conference 来自拉丁语 conferentia，意为聚集，源自 conferre（带到一起）。

items.en: Conferre meant to carry people or ideas into one place.
items.cn: conferre 意为把人或想法带到同一个地方。

items.en: Conferentia named the state of being gathered together.
items.cn: conferentia 指被聚集到一起的状态。

items.en: French conference named a formal meeting for talks.
items.cn: 法语 conference 指为商谈而举行的正式会面。

items.en: English conference first meant a conversation between parties.
items.cn: 英语 conference 最初指各方之间的交谈。

items.en: It now mainly names a large meeting of people with a shared interest.
items.cn: 如今它主要指有共同兴趣的人举行的大型会议。

note.en: The look-alike group holds nouns built from the same Latin root, and the meaning group names other kinds of gathering.
note.cn: 形近组收的是由同一拉丁词根构成的名词，近义组列出其他类型的聚会。

entries.definition: the act of giving an honour
the giving of a degree or right
the place where two rivers meet
an event where people come together to talk
a large meeting of people with one interest
a small class for discussion and study

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from a long table full of microphones, then move to a small closed room and to name badges.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从摆满麦克风的长桌开始，再走到一间关起门的小屋与一排名牌。

normal.en: Confer plus -ence is the noun of bringing people together.
normal.cn: confer 加 -ence，就是把人们聚到一起这件事的名词。

normal.en: A conference is a room where every chair faces the same screen.
normal.cn: 会议就是每把椅子都朝向同一块屏幕的房间。

normal.en: A press conference is a short meeting built for questions.
normal.cn: 记者招待会就是为提问而设的短会。

normal.en: The conference badge tells others which subject you came for.
normal.cn: 会议名牌会告诉别人你是为哪个主题而来。

normal.en: In conference, people confer, and then they return to work.
normal.cn: 在会议里人们商议，然后回到工作中。

abstract.en: Picture a forest of name cards on a long table.
abstract.cn: 想象一长桌上立起一片名牌。

abstract.en: Picture a hundred voices dropping to a whisper.
abstract.cn: 想象上百个声音一起降到耳语。

abstract.en: Picture one slide lighting a dark hall.
abstract.cn: 想象一张幻灯片照亮昏暗的大厅。

examples.en: She gave a talk at the conference on climate.
examples.cn: 她在气候会议上做了报告。

examples.en: The two leaders held a private conference.
examples.cn: 两位领导人举行了私下商谈。

examples.en: Our conference room is booked all morning.
examples.cn: 我们的会议室整个上午都被订满了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 conference 记成 confer（带到一起）加 ence：把许多人带到同一个房间，就是会议。

root: 源自拉丁语 conferentia（con 一起 + ferre 携带），本义是聚到一起，后指大型会议与私下协商。

sensesIntro.en: From people carried into one hall, to a few people talking behind a door, and finally to the meeting itself.
sensesIntro.cn: 从被带进同一大厅的人群，到关起门交谈的少数人，最后到会议本身。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: many chairs, one long table, and everyone facing the same subject.
core.cn: 核心意象：许多椅子、一张长桌，所有人都朝向同一个主题。

branches.en: The large meeting is the public and formal side of the word.
branches.cn: 大型会议是这个词公开而正式的一面。

branches.en: The private talk is the same idea behind a closed door.
branches.cn: 私下商谈是同一个意思关起门来的样子。

branches.en: Both sizes of meeting exist to move a subject forward.
branches.cn: 两种规模的会议都为了推动一个议题。

branches.en: A conference is measured by what people carry home from it.
branches.cn: 衡量一场会议，看人们从中带走了什么。

branches.en: A short conference can settle what a long debate cannot.
branches.cn: 一场短商谈有时能解决长辩论解决不了的事。

intro.en: Conference is Latin com-, together, plus ferre, to carry, with the noun ending -ence.
intro.cn: conference 由拉丁语 com-（一起）、ferre（携带）与名词词尾 -ence 构成。

latinIntro.en: The Latin carry base fer- also appears in transfer and refer.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语的携带词基 fer- 也出现在 transfer 与 refer 中。

items.example: She attends three conferences a year.

items.exampleCN: 评审团今晚将进行商议。

items.example: The conferment of the medal was brief.
The conferral of rights took years.
items.exampleCN: 这些权利的授予花了好几年。

items.meaning: holding meetings by phone or video
items.example: The team uses video conferencing daily.
items.exampleCN: 这个团队每天使用视频会议。

items.meaning: a meeting held to answer journalists
items.example: The coach called a press conference.
items.exampleCN: 教练召开了一场记者招待会。

items.meaning: to carry across to another place
items.example: Please transfer the call to my office.
items.exampleCN: 请把电话转接到我的办公室。

definition_en: a feeling of trust in yourself or in another person
core_image: 演讲者走上台时背挺得笔直，步子稳稳的
scene: 排练多次之后，她走上台时一点也不慌。Practice gave her the confidence to speak in public.
sceneCN: 这里 confidence 指「自信」（第 1 个义项：对自己能力的信任）；句意是练习给了她当众讲话的自信。

senses.title: Trust in yourself
senses.definition: a calm belief that you can do something well
senses.definitionCN: 平静地相信自己能把事情做好
senses.example: She answered every question with confidence.
senses.exampleCN: 她信心十足地回答了每个问题。
senses.why: Repeated practice turns a shaky hope into steady certainty.
senses.whyCN: 反复练习把摇晃的希望变成稳定的确信。

senses.title: Trust in another person
senses.definition: a feeling that someone or something can be relied on
senses.definitionCN: 觉得某人或某物可以依靠的感觉
senses.example: I have great confidence in your judgement.
senses.exampleCN: 我非常信任你的判断。
senses.why: Trust is a bet placed on someone else's steadiness.
senses.whyCN: 信任是把赌注押在别人的稳当上。

senses.title: A secret shared privately
senses.definition: a secret told to someone with a promise of silence
senses.definitionCN: 在对方承诺保密的情况下说出的秘密
senses.example: They exchanged confidences late at night.
senses.exampleCN: 他们在深夜交换了彼此的秘密。
senses.why: To trust someone with a secret is to lend them part of yourself.
senses.whyCN: 把秘密托付给人，就是把一部分自己借给了对方。

intro.en: Confidence comes from Latin confidentia, a trusting, from confidere, to trust completely.
intro.cn: confidence 来自拉丁语 confidentia，意为信赖，源自 confidere（完全信任）。

items.en: Fidere meant to trust or have faith in someone.
items.cn: fidere 意为信任或对某人抱有信心。

items.en: Confidere added com- to make the trust complete.
items.cn: confidere 加上 com-，表示彻底地信任。

items.en: French confidence named a firm hope or assurance.
items.cn: 法语 confidence 指坚定的希望或把握。

items.en: English confidence first meant reliance on another person.
items.cn: 英语 confidence 最初指对他人的依靠。

items.en: It now also means belief in oneself and a secret told in trust.
items.cn: 如今它也指对自己的信心，以及在信任中吐露的秘密。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words from the same trust family, and the meaning group names other kinds of assurance.
note.cn: 形近组收的是同一信任词族的词，近义组列出其他表示把握的说法。

entries.definition: sure about one's own ability
meant to be kept secret
a person you tell private things to
a feeling of certainty about something
the state of being completely sure
belief that someone is honest and reliable

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from a steady walk onto a stage, then move to a friend's promise and to a whispered secret.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从稳步走上舞台开始，再走到朋友的承诺与低声说出的秘密。

normal.en: Con- is fully and fid- is trust, so confidence is complete trust, in yourself or in others.
normal.cn: con- 是完全，fid- 是信任，所以 confidence 就是彻底的信任，对自己或对别人。

normal.en: Confidence does not shout; it walks in quietly and sits down.
normal.cn: 自信不会大声喊，它安静地走进来然后坐下。

normal.en: A vote of confidence is other people lending you their trust.
normal.cn: 信任投票，就是别人把他们的信任借给你。

normal.en: Confidence and confidential both come from trust, one is belief and one is a secret.
normal.cn: confidence 与 confidential 都来自信任，一个是相信，一个是秘密。

normal.en: Say a thing in confidence, and it must stay in that room.
normal.cn: 以保密的方式说出一件事，它就必须留在那个房间里。

abstract.en: Picture a straight back and an even step.
abstract.cn: 想象一条笔直的背与均匀的步伐。

abstract.en: Picture a handshake that does not hurry.
abstract.cn: 想象一次不急不忙的握手。

abstract.en: Picture a key handed over with a promise.
abstract.cn: 想象一把钥匙连同承诺一起交出。

examples.en: Practice slowly built her confidence on stage.
examples.cn: 练习慢慢建立起了她在台上的自信。

examples.en: The manager has full confidence in the new team.
examples.cn: 经理对新团队有充分的信心。

examples.en: He told me the news in confidence.
examples.cn: 他私下把这个消息告诉了我。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 confidence 记成 con（完全）加 fid（信任）加 ence：完全相信自己，是自信；完全相信别人，是信任。

root: 源自拉丁语 confidentia（com 完全 + fidere 信任），本义是完全的信赖，后引申为自信、信任与私下吐露的秘密。

sensesIntro.en: From trust in your own step, to trust placed in another, and finally to a secret kept between two people.
sensesIntro.cn: 从对自己步伐的信任，到交给别人的信任，最后到两人之间守住的秘密。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a steady figure walking on stage, and a key passed quietly to a friend.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个稳稳走上台的人，以及一把被悄悄交给朋友的钥匙。

branches.en: Self confidence grows from doing the same thing many times.
branches.cn: 自信来自把同一件事做上许多遍。

branches.en: Confidence in others is a judgement about their reliability.
branches.cn: 对他人的信任，是对其可靠程度的判断。

branches.en: A confidence shared is a secret placed in safe hands.
branches.cn: 被分享的秘密，是放进可靠之手的秘密。

branches.en: Both kinds of confidence are tested only when something goes wrong.
branches.cn: 两种信心都只有在出问题时才真正受到检验。

branches.en: Trust is what lets a secret be told at all.
branches.cn: 正因为信任，秘密才可能被说出口。

intro.en: Confidence is built on Latin com-, fully, plus fidere, to trust, with the noun ending -ence.
intro.cn: confidence 由拉丁语 com-（完全）、fidere（信任）与名词词尾 -ence 构成。

latinIntro.en: The Latin trust base fid- also appears in fidelity and faith.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语的信任词基 fid- 也出现在 fidelity 与 faith 中。

items.example: Her confidence grew with each attempt.
items.exampleCN: 每尝试一次，她的信心就增长一些。

items.example: He is confident about the result.

items.meaning: in a sure and steady way
items.example: She walked confidently to the front.

items.meaning: to tell a secret to someone you trust
faithfulness to a person or promise
items.example: The team values fidelity to its word.
items.exampleCN: 这个团队重视信守承诺。

items.meaning: a scam that gains someone's trust first
items.example: The caller ran a confidence trick.
items.exampleCN: 来电者设下了一个信任骗局。

definition_en: sure that you can do something, or that something will happen
core_image: 球员站在罚球线前，抬头看了一眼篮筐
scene: 她走进面试房间时，肩膀放松，眼神平稳。She felt confident enough to answer without notes.
sceneCN: 这里 confident 指「自信的」（第 1 个义项：对自己的能力有把握）；句意是她自信到可以不用稿子回答问题。

pos.zh: 自信的；有把握的；确信的

senses.title: Sure of oneself
senses.definition: feeling sure about your own ability to do something
senses.definitionCN: 对自己的做事能力感到有把握
senses.example: He looked confident in front of the crowd.
senses.exampleCN: 他在人群面前显得很自信。
senses.why: A person who has done the work many times stops doubting each step.
senses.whyCN: 一件事做过许多遍的人，不再怀疑每一步。

senses.title: Sure that something will happen
senses.definition: feeling certain that a result will come about
senses.definitionCN: 确信某个结果将会出现
senses.example: We are confident that the plan will work.
senses.exampleCN: 我们确信这个计划会奏效。
senses.why: Evidence gathered over time can turn a guess into a firm expectation.
senses.whyCN: 长期积累的证据能把猜测变成坚定的预期。

intro.en: Confident comes from Latin confidere, to trust completely, built from com-, fully, and fidere, to trust.
intro.cn: confident 来自拉丁语 confidere，意为完全信任，由 com-（完全）与 fidere（信任）构成。

items.en: Fidere meant to trust someone or to have faith.
items.cn: fidere 意为信任某人或怀有信念。

items.en: Confidere described a trust that had become complete.
items.cn: confidere 描述一种已经变得完全的信任。

items.en: Confidens named a person full of trust in himself.
items.cn: confidens 指一个对自己充满信任的人。

items.en: French confident meant bold and sure of oneself.
items.cn: 法语 confident 意为大胆而对自己有把握。

items.en: English confident now means sure of oneself or sure of a result.
items.cn: 英语 confident 如今指对自己或对结果有把握。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words from the same trust family, and the meaning group names other ways of being sure.
note.cn: 形近组收的是同一信任词族的词，近义组列出其他表示有把握的说法。

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from a steady stand at a free-throw line, then move to a job interview and to a clear forecast.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从罚球线上稳稳站定开始，再走到求职面试与一份清楚的预报。

normal.en: Confide plus -ent gives confident, the one who trusts and is trusted.
normal.cn: confide 加 -ent 得到 confident，就是信任也值得信任的人。

normal.en: Confident does not mean loud; it means your hands do not shake.
normal.cn: confident 不是声音大，而是手不抖。

normal.en: A confident player still practises, but stops fearing the shot.
normal.cn: 自信的球员仍然练习，只是不再怕那一投。

normal.en: Be confident about the work, and let the result speak.
normal.cn: 对工作保持自信，让结果说话。

normal.en: Confident means the answer is already in your pocket.
normal.cn: confident 就是答案早已放在口袋里。

abstract.en: Picture a hand that does not reach for the notes.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手不再去摸讲稿。

abstract.en: Picture a foot placed firmly behind a line.
abstract.cn: 想象一只脚稳稳踩在线后。

abstract.en: Picture a calm face before a big door opens.
abstract.cn: 想象一扇大门打开前那张平静的脸。

examples.en: She is confident about her spoken English now.
examples.cn: 她现在对自己的英语口语很有信心。

examples.en: The team is confident of winning the final.
examples.cn: 这支队伍确信能赢下决赛。

examples.en: He gave a confident answer without hesitating.
examples.cn: 他毫不犹豫地给出了一个有把握的回答。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 confident 记成 con（完全）加 fid（信任）加 ent：完全相信自己的人，就是自信的。

root: 源自拉丁语 confidere（com 完全 + fidere 信任），本义是完全信赖，后引申为自信的与确信的。

sensesIntro.en: From trust in one's own hands, to certainty about a future result.
sensesIntro.cn: 从对自己双手的信任，到对将来结果的确定。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a calm figure standing straight, with the answer already prepared.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个站得笔直、答案早已备好的人。

branches.en: Self trust shows in a relaxed body and an even voice.
branches.cn: 对自己的信任，表现在放松的身体与平稳的嗓音上。

branches.en: Confidence about a result rests on evidence, not wishes.
branches.cn: 对结果的把握靠证据，而不是愿望。

branches.en: Both kinds of confidence make a person act without delay.
branches.cn: 两种信心都让人不再拖延行动。

branches.en: A confident person can still be wrong, but is not frozen by fear.
branches.cn: 自信的人也可能判断错，只是不会被恐惧冻住。

branches.en: A confident forecast is one that has survived testing.
branches.cn: 有把握的预测，是经受过检验的预测。

intro.en: Confident is built on Latin com-, fully, plus fidere, to trust, with the adjective ending -ent.

definition_en: to keep something within limits, or to keep a person in one place
core_image: 一圈低矮的篱笆，把羊群圈在草地内
scene: 医生嘱咐他把活动范围限制在家里。The doctor told him to confine his activity to the house.
sceneCN: 这里 confine 指「限制」（第 1 个义项：把范围限定在某个界限内）；句意是医生嘱咐他把活动范围限制在家里。

senses.title: Keep within limits
senses.definition: to keep an activity or subject inside a fixed limit
senses.definitionCN: 把活动或话题限定在固定的范围之内
senses.example: Please confine your remarks to the topic.
senses.exampleCN: 请把发言限制在这个话题之内。
senses.why: A boundary makes a discussion sharp instead of endless.
senses.whyCN: 有了边界，讨论才会集中，而不是漫无边际。

senses.title: Keep in one place
senses.definition: to keep a person or animal in a closed space
senses.definitionCN: 把人或动物关在封闭的空间里
senses.example: The prisoner was confined to a small cell.
senses.exampleCN: 那名囚犯被关在一间小牢房里。
senses.why: Walls do to a body what rules do to a topic.
senses.whyCN: 墙对身体的限制，正如规则对话题的限制。

intro.en: Confine comes from Latin confinare, to share a border, from com-, together, and finis, a boundary.
intro.cn: confine 来自拉丁语 confinare，意为共有一条边界，由 com-（一起）与 finis（边界）构成。

items.en: Finis meant the end or the border of a place.
items.cn: finis 意为一个地方的终端或边界。

items.en: Confinare meant to place something inside a border.
items.cn: confinare 意为把某物放进边界之内。

items.en: Old French confiner meant to keep within a district.
items.cn: 古法语 confiner 意为把某物限制在一个区域内。

items.en: English confine first meant to border on a place.
items.cn: 英语 confine 最初指与某地接壤。

items.en: It now means to limit a subject or shut a person in.
items.cn: 如今它指限制一个话题，或把人关起来。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words that begin like confine, and the meaning group names other ways of setting limits.
note.cn: 形近组收的是与 confine 词形相近的词，近义组列出其他设定限界的说法。
