items.exampleCN: 这次修理花了一笔不小的钱。

items.example: It was considerate of you to call.

items.meaning: in a way that shows care for others
items.example: She spoke considerately to the child.
Loud music at midnight is inconsiderate.
items.exampleCN: 半夜大声放音乐是不替别人着想。

items.meaning: when you take the facts into account
items.example: She did well, considering her age.
items.exampleCN: 考虑到她的年龄，她做得很好。

items.meaning: to think about a choice once more

definition_en: to be made up of particular parts, or to have something as its central point
core_image: 一只碗里盛着几样分辨得清的配料
scene: 厨师示范前先说明汤里放了什么。The soup consists of tomatoes, beans and a little salt.
sceneCN: 这里 consist 指「由…组成」（第 1 个义项：整体由若干部分构成）；句意是这道汤由番茄、豆子和少量盐组成。

senses.title: Made of parts
senses.definition: to be made up of particular parts or elements
senses.definitionCN: 整体由若干具体部分构成
senses.example: The team consists of six engineers.
senses.exampleCN: 这个团队由六名工程师组成。
senses.why: You cannot name a whole without naming what stands inside it.
senses.whyCN: 要说清一个整体，就得说清里面站着什么。

senses.title: Lying in
senses.definition: to have something as its essential point or quality
senses.definitionCN: 以某事为其根本要点或性质
senses.example: True comfort consists in wanting less.
senses.exampleCN: 真正的自在在于欲求更少。
senses.why: Some things are not built of parts but rest on one idea.
senses.whyCN: 有些事物不是由零件搭成，而是靠一个念头立住。

senses.title: Standing together
senses.definition: to be in agreement with something, an older and rarer sense
senses.definitionCN: 与某事物相符合，是较古老且少用的义项
senses.example: The two reports consist with each other.
senses.exampleCN: 这两份报告彼此吻合。
senses.why: Things that stand together also tend to tell the same story.
senses.whyCN: 站在一起的东西，往往也讲着同一个故事。

intro.en: Consist comes from Latin consistere, to stand together, built from com-, together, and sistere, to stand.
intro.cn: consist 来自拉丁语 consistere，意为站在一起，由 com-（一起）与 sistere（站立）构成。

items.en: Sistere meant to stand still or take a stand.
items.cn: sistere 意为站定或站住立场。

items.en: Consistere meant to take a firm position together.
items.cn: consistere 意为一起站定位置。

items.en: Later Latin gave it the sense of being made of parts.
items.cn: 后来的拉丁语赋予它由部分构成的含义。

items.en: French consister narrowed to being composed of something.
items.cn: 法语 consister 收窄为由某物构成。

items.en: English consist kept both the standing and the composed senses.
items.cn: 英语 consist 同时保留了站定与构成两层意思。

items.en: Today the pattern consist of is by far the most common.
items.cn: 今天 consist of 这一搭配最为常用。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin stand base sist-, and the meaning group names other ways of saying what a whole is made of.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁语的站立词基 sist-，近义组列出其他表示整体由何构成的说法。

entries.definition: always behaving or happening in the same way
to say firmly that something must happen
to keep going even when it is hard
to have particular parts as its contents
to make up the parts of a whole
to have something inside

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from parts standing together, then move to the one point a thing rests on and to old agreement.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从各部分站在一起开始，再到一件事所依托的那个要点，最后到古老的相一致义。

normal.en: Con- is together and sist is stand, so consist is parts standing together.
normal.cn: con- 是一起，sist 是站立，consist 就是各部分站在一起。

normal.en: Take the soup apart in your mind, and you have consist of.
normal.cn: 在心里把那碗汤拆开来看，你就得到了 consist of。

normal.en: Consist of names the parts, while consist in names the point.
normal.cn: consist of 点出部分，consist in 点出要害。

normal.en: A chair consists of legs, a seat and a back, yet you still see one chair.
normal.cn: 椅子由腿、座面和靠背组成，可你看到的仍是一把椅子。

normal.en: Ask what it is made of, then ask what it really rests on.
normal.cn: 先问它由什么做成，再问它究竟靠什么立住。

abstract.en: Picture four stones holding up one flat slab.
abstract.cn: 想象四块石头托起一块平板。

abstract.en: Picture a row of ingredients laid beside a pot.
abstract.cn: 想象一排配料摆在锅边。

abstract.en: Picture a rope made of many thin threads.
abstract.cn: 想象一根由许多细线拧成的绳子。

examples.en: The course consists of ten short lessons.
examples.cn: 这门课由十节短课组成。

examples.en: Happiness does not consist in having more.
examples.cn: 幸福并不在于拥有更多。

examples.en: A good meal consists of simple things done well.
examples.cn: 一顿好饭由几样做得到位的简单食材组成。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 consist 记成 con（一起）加 sist（站立）：几样东西站在一起构成一个整体，就是由…组成。

root: 源自拉丁语 consistere（com 一起 + sistere 站立），本义是一起站定，后指由若干部分构成、要点在于。

sensesIntro.en: From parts standing together, to the point a thing rests on, and at last to an older sense of agreement.
sensesIntro.cn: 从各部分站在一起，到一件事所依托的要点，最后到较为古老的相一致之义。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: several stones standing shoulder to shoulder under one slab.
core.cn: 核心意象：几块石头并肩立在同一块石板之下。

branches.en: The commonest sense simply lists what a whole is made of.
branches.cn: 最常用的义项只是列出整体由什么构成。

branches.en: The second sense points to the one idea a thing rests on.
branches.cn: 第二个义项指向一件事所依托的那一个念头。

branches.en: The old sense says two things can stand without contradiction.
branches.cn: 古老义项说的是两件事能并立而不相矛盾。

branches.en: Both senses answer the question of what something really is.
branches.cn: 两个义项都在回答某物究竟是什么。

branches.en: A thing that rests on one point can also agree with another.
branches.cn: 依托于一个要点的事物，也能与另一事物相合。

intro.en: Consist is built on Latin com-, together, plus sistere, to stand.
intro.cn: consist 由拉丁语 com-（一起）与 sistere（站立）构成。

latinIntro.en: The Latin stand base sist- also appears in insist, persist and resist.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语的站立词基 sist- 也出现在 insist、persist 与 resist 中。

items.meaning: to be made of parts standing together
items.meaningCN: 由站在一起的部分构成
